literal: Then he and Pi Jinghe held a host of a hundred thousand on the north bank of the Huai and did not advance.
idiomatic: He and Pi Jinghe held a hundred thousand on the north bank of the Huai and did not advance.

literal: In Shouyang city a blue-black dragon rose to heaven; the city soon fell.
idiomatic: A blue-black dragon rose from Shouyang; the city soon fell.

literal: Qian and Mobile Staff Vice Director Wang Guixian, Special Advancement Prince of Baling Wang Lin, Prince of Fufeng Kezhuhun Xiaoyu, Martial Guard General Xi Yongle, Peer Suo Jinghe, Governor of Renzhou Li Bowei, Governor of Huozhou Feng Zixiu, Governor of Taizhou Gao Zizhi, Mobile Staff Left Aide Li Taotu, and other supervising generals—fifty-eight in all—and ten thousand soldiers were all lost.
idiomatic: Qian, mobile staff vice director Wang Guixian, special advancement Prince of Baling Wang Lin, Prince of Fufeng Kezhuhun Xiaoyu, martial guard general Xi Yongle, peer Suo Jinghe, governors Li Bowei, Feng Zixiu, and Gao Zizhi, mobile staff left aide Li Taotu, and fifty-eight other supervising generals with ten thousand soldiers were all lost.

literal: The Chen killed Wang Lin; the rest were all imprisoned in the eastern foundry.
idiomatic: The Chen killed Wang Lin; the rest were imprisoned in the eastern foundry.

literal: The Chen ruler wished to know Qi's strength and weakness, so he released Qian and said: "Prisoners originally belong to Youzhou; of Hebei's smallest districts one has five hundred thousand people—those who fell to Chen are only you and Li Bowei."
idiomatic: The Chen ruler wished to know Qi's strength and released Qian, saying: "Prisoners belong to Youzhou; of Hebei's smallest districts there are five hundred thousand people—those who fell to Chen are only you and Li Bowei."

literal: At the time Li Taotu was about to escape and return, and also urged Qian.
idiomatic: Li Taotu was about to escape and urged Qian to come.

literal: Qian said: "With this face of mine, how could I deceive people?
idiomatic: Qian said: "With this face, how could I deceive anyone?"

literal: In my youth a physiognomist said I would perish in Wu-Yue lands.
idiomatic: In youth a physiognomist said I would die in Wu-Yue.

literal: Life and death are already fixed; brother, go on your way.
idiomatic: Life and death are fixed; brother, go.

literal: He then sent a letter to his younger brother Shi Sui saying: "I dreamed you would fall ill on such-and-such month and day, and on such-and-such month and day would gradually recover."
idiomatic: He sent a letter to his brother Shi Sui: "I dreamed you would fall ill on such a day and recover on such a day."

literal: It all happened as he said.
idiomatic: It all came true.

literal: Then he sighed: "Shouyang has fallen; I ought to have splashed the city with the blood of my neck, but Buddhism forbids suicide, so I have dragged on in stolen life—now I may die!"
idiomatic: Then he sighed: "Shouyang has fallen; I should have dyed the walls with my neck's blood, but Buddhism forbids suicide, so I dragged on—now I may die!"

literal: Thereupon he held his breath and died.
idiomatic: He held his breath and died.

literal: His family bought back the corpse for burial; he was posthumously enfeoffed Peer with Protocol Equal to Three Excellencies, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Governor of Yanzhou.
idiomatic: His family bought back the corpse for burial; he was posthumously peer with protocol equal to the Three Excellencies, left vice director of the masters of writing, and governor of Yanzhou.

literal: He had no son; his younger brother Shi Sui's son Yuan Xiaosi was made heir.
idiomatic: He had no son; his brother Shi Sui's son Yuan Xiaosi was made heir.

literal: Qian's nature was upright and firm by habit.
idiomatic: Qian was upright and firm by nature.

literal: His grandfather Ting often wanted Qian to entrap Governor of Renzhou Liu Di and promised him high office.
idiomatic: His grandfather Ting often wanted Qian to entrap Renzhou governor Liu Di and promised high office.

literal: Qian said: "Such a thing I will not do."
idiomatic: Qian said: "I will not do such a thing."

literal: Mobile Staff Chief Murong Shide often promoted and valued him; when ill he told his son: "Director Lu taught me how to live, like elder and younger brothers.
idiomatic: Mobile staff chief Murong Shide often valued him; when ill he told his son: "Director Lu taught me to live like brothers."

literal: When I die, present him with the best chestnut-colored horse.
idiomatic: When I die, give him my best chestnut horse."

literal: The son took another horse.
idiomatic: The son brought another horse.

literal: When Shide's bier went out the gate it stopped of itself and could not move; the shaman said Shide's voice angrily said: "Why not give Director Lu the chestnut horse I rode?"
idiomatic: Shide's bier stopped at the gate and would not move; the shaman said Shide angrily asked why they had not given Director Lu the chestnut horse he rode.

literal: The son hastily obeyed, and then the bier moved.
idiomatic: The son obeyed at once, and the bier moved.

literal: Qian used the horse's price for merit-making.
idiomatic: Qian used the horse's price for merit-making.

literal: Such was the esteem in which he was held.
idiomatic: Such was the esteem he commanded.

literal: Shi Sui, styled Ziyan, in youth was known to Cui Ang.
idiomatic: Shi Sui, styled Ziyan, was known in youth to Cui Ang.

literal: Ang said: "These brothers are enough to be outstanding men of the later generation—only a pity they do not read books."
idiomatic: Ang said: "These brothers could be the finest of their generation—only it is a pity they do not read."

literal: Posts: Left and Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Director in the Ministry of Personnel, Administrator of Zhongshan with concurrent Chief Clerk of Dingzhou.
idiomatic: He reached left and right vice director of the masters of writing, director in the ministry of personnel, and administrator of Zhongshan with concurrent chief clerk of Dingzhou.

literal: After Qi perished he died.
idiomatic: After Qi fell he died.

literal: When Dushi was in Jizhou, in early Wei the city of Shengcheng was pacified.
idiomatic: When Dushi was in Jizhou, in early Wei Shengcheng was pacified.

literal: Wu salt Fang Chongji's mother Fu—Dushi's wife by succession from his maternal cousin's son's wife—and Jia, wife of Yanzhou Governor Shen Zuan, Chongji's aunt's daughter, were both ruined in war, old, ill, and wasted.
idiomatic: Fang Chongji's mother Fu of Wuyan—Dushi's wife by succession through his maternal cousin's son's wife—and Jia, wife of Yanzhou governor Shen Zuan, Chongji's aunt's daughter, were ruined in war, old, ill, and wasted.

literal: Yet Dushi reckoned middle and outer kin and sent them support.
idiomatic: Yet Dushi reckoned kinship and sent them support.

literal: Whenever he saw the Lady Fu he knelt to ask after her health and at each season sent clothing and food;
idiomatic: Whenever he saw Lady Fu he knelt to ask after her and sent clothing and food each season;

literal: he also relieved the Lady Jia and supplied her meals.
idiomatic: he also relieved Lady Jia and supplied her meals.

literal: When Qingzhou fell, many of the Cui clan were cast down and he ransomed many.
idiomatic: When Qingzhou fell many Cui were ruined and he ransomed many.

literal: Boyuan, Chang, and the rest all followed their fathers' manner.
idiomatic: Boyuan, Chang, and the rest all followed their fathers' ways.

literal: Distant and close kin he ranked as elders; none failed to bow in full respect.
idiomatic: Distant and close kin he treated as elders; all bowed to him in respect.

literal: Household ritual was praised by the age.
idiomatic: Household ritual was praised in the age.

literal: Humble, retiring, and simple, he did not compete with the world.
idiomatic: He was humble, retiring, and simple and did not compete with the world.

literal: After his parents died they lived together sharing property—from grandfather to grandson, a hundred mouths within the house.
idiomatic: After his parents died they lived together sharing property—from grandfather to grandson, a hundred mouths in one house.

literal: In Luoyang there was a famine year and no means to support themselves, yet elders and juniors were harmonious and rich and poor shared alike.
idiomatic: In Luoyang in a famine year they could not support themselves, yet elders and juniors were harmonious and rich and poor shared alike.

literal: Close cousins would each morning visit their fathers, sit in a separate room, and only at evening enter the inner quarters.
idiomatic: Close cousins each morning visited their fathers, sat in a separate room, and only at evening entered within.

literal: Outside court and office they did not socialize idly.
idiomatic: Outside court and office they did not socialize lightly.

literal: They urged one another with ritual thus.
idiomatic: They urged one another with ritual thus.

literal: Moreover one household had three lords—a glory of the age.
idiomatic: Moreover one household had three lords, a glory of the age.

literal: After Boyuan's brothers died and after Daojiang died, the family manner declined.
idiomatic: After Boyuan's brothers and Daojiang died, the family manner declined.

literal: Descendants often acted unlawfully; inner chambers were foul and mixed, and they were despised by the time.
idiomatic: Descendants often broke the law; inner chambers were foul, and contemporaries despised them.

literal: Dushi's younger cousin Shenbao, post: Doctor of the Palace Secretariat.
idiomatic: Dushi's cousin Shenbao was doctor of the palace secretariat.

literal: Emperor Xiaowen for his younger brother Prince of Gaoyang Wang Yong took Shenbao's daughter as consort.
idiomatic: Xiaowen for his brother Prince of Gaoyang Wang Yong took Shenbao's daughter as consort.

literal: Earlier, Xuan's elder cousin's brother Pu, at the end of Murong Bao's reign, controlled the district by the sea, killed more than ten of his village kin and elders, styled himself Defender-General of the North and Governor of Youzhou, and raided prefectures and counties.
idiomatic: Earlier Xuan's elder cousin's brother Pu, at the end of Murong Bao's reign, controlled the coast district, killed more than ten village kin and elders, styled himself defender-general of the north and governor of Youzhou, and raided prefectures.

literal: In the Tianxing era he was captured in the punitive campaign.
idiomatic: In Tianxing he was captured in the punitive campaign.

literal: Pu's great-grandson Hong, styled Zengsun.
idiomatic: Pu's great-grandson was Hong, styled Zengsun.

literal: In the Taihe era posts: Doctor of the Palace Secretariat, Administrator of Leling and Yangping, Rectifier of Youzhou.
idiomatic: In Taihe he was doctor of the palace secretariat, administrator of Leling and Yangping, and rectifier of Youzhou.

literal: Hong had three sons.
idiomatic: Hong had three sons.

literal: The eldest son Chong had early established a fine name; men of discernment promised him great future, but he died as Legal Affairs Aide in the Fast Cavalry Office.
idiomatic: The eldest Chong early won a fine name; discerning men promised him a great future, but he died as legal affairs aide in the fast cavalry office.

literal: Chong's son was Rou.
idiomatic: Chong's son was Rou.

literal: Rou, styled Zigang.
idiomatic: Rou was styled Zigang.

literal: Orphaned young, he was raised by his aunt, who cared for him more than for her own sons.
idiomatic: Orphaned young, he was raised by his aunt, who cared for him more than her own sons.

literal: Rou devoted himself in warm attendance as to his own kin; kin praised and valued him.
idiomatic: Rou served her with full devotion as to his own kin; kin praised him.

literal: By nature clever and fond of learning, before the cap he could compose linked prose.
idiomatic: Clever and fond of learning, before the cap he could compose linked prose.

literal: But he stammered and could not sustain debate.
idiomatic: But he stammered and could not sustain debate.

literal: He rather indulged wine and wild conduct, for which the age mocked him.
idiomatic: He indulged wine and wild conduct, for which the age mocked him.

literal: Prince of Linhuai Wang Yu saw and valued him, and gave him his daughter in marriage.
idiomatic: Prince of Linhuai Wang Yu valued him and gave him his daughter.

literal: When Emperor Xiaowu of Wei and Qi Shenwu had a rift, an edict had Heba Sheng go out to govern Jingzhou.
idiomatic: When Xiaowu of Wei and Qi Shenwu quarreled, an edict sent Heba Sheng to govern Jingzhou.

literal: Rou thought that through this he could achieve merit, and followed Sheng to Jingzhou.
idiomatic: Rou thought merit could be won thereby and followed Sheng to Jingzhou.

literal: Rou was made Director of the Great Mobile Staff, in charge of records; military affairs Rou largely shared in.
idiomatic: Rou was made director of the great mobile staff in charge of records; he largely shared in military affairs.

literal: When Sheng became Grand Tutor, Rou was made his aide.
idiomatic: When Sheng became grand tutor, Rou was made his aide.

literal: Later Xiaowu summoned Sheng to bring troops to Luoyang; Sheng asked Rou.
idiomatic: Later Xiaowu summoned Sheng to bring troops to Luoyang, and Sheng consulted Rou.

literal: Rou said: "Gao Huan relying on the armor of Jinyang—his intent is truly hard to know.
idiomatic: Rou said: "Gao Huan with Jinyang's armies behind him—his intent is hard to know."

literal: My lord ought to sweep forward to the capital and decide victory or defeat with him, life or death by that—this is the loyal man's upper stratagem.
idiomatic: You should sweep to the capital and decide victory with him, staking life and death on it—that is the loyal man's best plan."

literal: If you block north at Luyang, join south with the old Chu, link east with Yan and Yu, and connect west with Guanzhong, with a hundred thousand in armor watching for an opening to move—that is also the middle stratagem.
idiomatic: Block north at Luyang, join south with old Chu, link east with Yan and Yu, connect west with Guanzhong, keep a hundred thousand in armor and move when the moment comes—that is the middle plan."

literal: Raise the three Jing provinces, send terms to Liang, and you may shelter your person—but fame and merit are gone; that is the lower stratagem.
idiomatic: Raise the three Jing provinces and treat with Liang—you may save yourself, but fame and merit are gone; that is the worst plan."

literal: Sheng thought Rou young and laughed without answering.
idiomatic: Sheng deemed Rou too young and laughed without reply.

literal: When Xiaowu moved west, Eastern Wei sent Hou Jing to raid Xiang.
idiomatic: When Xiaowu fled west, Eastern Wei sent Hou Jing against Xiang.

literal: Sheng was defeated and fled south to Liang; Rou followed.
idiomatic: Sheng was beaten and fled south to Liang, Rou with him.

literal: Sheng repeatedly memorialized Emperor Wu of Liang asking to return to Guanzhong.
idiomatic: Sheng repeatedly memorialized Liang Wudi asking to return to Guanzhong.

literal: Liang Wudi read the memorials, admired their literary color, and knowing Rou had composed them, sent an attendant to console him and also gave silk brocade.
idiomatic: Wudi read the memorials, admired their style, learned Rou had written them, sent an attendant to console him, and gave silk brocade.

literal: Later he returned with Sheng; when they reached Xiangyang,
idiomatic: He later returned with Sheng; at Xiangyang,

literal: Qi Shenwu feared Sheng would enter west and sent Hou Jing with light cavalry to intercept.
idiomatic: Qi Shenwu feared Sheng would go west and sent Hou Jing with light cavalry to intercept.

literal: Sheng and Rou were afraid and abandoned the boats to travel by mountain, carrying grain on their backs through danger for several hundred li.
idiomatic: Sheng and Rou were afraid, abandoned their boats, went by mountain carrying grain on their backs through danger for several hundred li.

literal: It was autumn rains; companions who froze and starved were more than half, even unto death.
idiomatic: It was autumn rain; more than half the party froze and starved, many unto death.

literal: In the second year of Datong they reached Chang'an and he was enfeoffed Baron of Rongcheng.
idiomatic: In the second year of Datong they reached Chang'an; he was enfeoffed Baron of Rongcheng.

literal: Zhou Wendi brought him in as mobile staff director, then made him Attendant Gentleman.
idiomatic: Zhou Wendi brought him in as mobile staff director, then attendant gentleman.

literal: With Director Su Chuo he managed secrets.
idiomatic: With director Su Chuo he managed secrets.

literal: At the time of the Shaye campaign the great army won repeatedly; between Ru and Ying many rose in allegiance.
idiomatic: At the Shaye campaign the army won repeatedly; between Ru and Ying many rose in allegiance.

literal: Letters went back and forth, more than a hundred documents a day; Rou answered as occasion required, all fitting the matter.
idiomatic: Letters went back and forth, more than a hundred a day; Rou answered as occasion required, all fitting the matter.

literal: He was advanced to Baronet.
idiomatic: He was advanced to baronet.

literal: He rose repeatedly to Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrently in the Historiography Office writing the Straight Residence Annals.
idiomatic: He rose to vice director of the secretariat, concurrently writing the straight residence annals.

literal: Later he was Yellow Gate Attendant; Zhou Wen knew he was poor and gave him his own robe.
idiomatic: Later he was yellow gate attendant; Zhou Wen knew he was poor and gave him his robe.

literal: Later he was promoted to Director of the Secretariat.
idiomatic: Later he was promoted to director of the secretariat.

literal: When Zhou Xiaomin Di ascended the throne he was appointed Junior Inner History Grandee, advanced to Peer with Protocol Equal to Three Excellencies, and died in office.
idiomatic: When Zhou Xiaomin Di ascended he was junior inner history grandee, advanced to peer with protocol equal to the Three Excellencies, and died in office.

literal: Poems, eulogies, steles, inscriptions, proclamations, memorials, and reports he composed that circulated in the world number several tens.
idiomatic: Poems, eulogies, steles, inscriptions, proclamations, memorials, and reports circulating in the world number several tens.

literal: His son Kai succeeded.
idiomatic: His son Kai succeeded.

literal: Kai, styled Changren.
idiomatic: Kai was styled Changren.

literal: Filial and friendly by nature, keen in spirit and quick to understand, he ranged through classics and histories and had talent for the age, and could compose linked prose fairly well.
idiomatic: Filial and friendly, keen and quick to understand, he ranged through classics and histories, had talent for the age, and could compose linked prose fairly well.

literal: Prince of Qi Wang Xian brought him in as recorder.
idiomatic: Prince of Qi Wang Xian brought him in as recorder.

literal: Following Xian's campaign against Qi he persuaded Qi to surrender the garrison of Baishe.
idiomatic: Following Xian's campaign against Qi he persuaded Qi to surrender Baishe garrison.

literal: He was promoted to Junior Director of the Ministry of Personnel.
idiomatic: He was promoted to junior director of the ministry of personnel.

literal: At the time the dyer Wang Shenhuan advanced by bribery; Grand Minister Yuwen Hu promoted him to Director under the Ministry of Revenue.
idiomatic: At the time dyer Wang Shenhuan advanced by bribery; Grand Minister Yuwen Hu made him director under the ministry of revenue.

literal: Kai remonstrated: "In antiquity, one who from a high place could compose rhapsodies might become a grandee;
idiomatic: Kai remonstrated: "In antiquity one who from a high place could compose rhapsodies might become a grandee;
